question: Do areas identified as e-bike opportunities also correspond to places where cycling can materially improve access to everyday needs?
method: Descriptive overlap only -- e-bike Opportunity/Readiness (frozen Phase 6B-V2 MCDA baseline) was NOT used to compute cycling accessibility, and cycling accessibility results were NOT fed back into the e-bike model.
interpretation_note: A positive overlap above the 25% citywide baseline would suggest the two frozen, independently-derived analyses (MCDA-based e-bike suitability and network-based cycling accessibility gain) are pointing at overlapping areas -- a potentially important framework-level cross-validation result. Any such overlap is descriptive co-location, not a causal or behavioral claim.
